sql: SELECT pickup_zone, AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance FROM nyc.trips GROUP BY pickup_zone
SELECT trip_id, trip_distance, fare_amount FROM nyc.trips WHERE passenger_count > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_trips FROM nyc.trips WHERE trip_distance > 30
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM nyc.trips GROUP BY payment_type
SELECT DATE(pickup_ts) AS day, SUM(fare_amount) AS revenue FROM nyc.trips GROUP BY DATE(pickup_ts)
